datasets.name: 84bdde06
queryLines:
-- Liste contrôlée des tables accessibles au Table Explorer.
-- Le catalogue est volontairement fixé à dbx_lab_dev.

SELECT
    table_schema AS schema_name,
    table_name,
    table_type
FROM dbx_lab_dev.information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema IN (
    'bronze',
    'silver',
    'gold',
    'landing',
    'monitoring'
)
AND table_type <> 'VIEW'
ORDER BY
    schema_name,
    table_name;
